title: yummy midnight chewy ukrainian foie-gras skillet
description: Satisfy your midnight cravings with this salty, chewy Ukrainian dish featuring foie-gras and a hint of fermentation. Keto-friendly and ready in under an hour!

ingredients.name: foie gras
ingredients.notes: keto-friendly choice, avoid store-bought options for better quality

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: himalayan pink salt for added depth

instructions: Heat the tava-griddle over medium heat for 5 minutes prior to cooking.
Add a tablespoon of butter to the tava-griddle and let it melt.
Add the chopped fennel and cook for 3 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
Add the foie gras and cook for 2 minutes on each side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F.
Add the chopped coriander, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt to the tava-griddle and stir to combine.
Add the toasted fennel seeds and stir to combine.
Top with black caviar, if using.
Transfer the skillet to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh coriander.
Let the skillet cool for 5 minutes prior to refrigerating or freezing.
